== List ==
=== List of Provincial Kuni no Miyatsuko ===
Before the ritsuryō system was implemented, Kuni no Miyatsuko existed; however, for convenience, they are classified based on the territory of the provinces of the ritsuryō system after the {{ill|9th century|en|9th century|qid=Q8083|lt=9th century}}.<ref>Referencing the “Kuni no Miyatsuko” section of the “Kokushi Daijiten” for the list of clans and Kuni no Miyatsuko.</ref>

=== Kuni no Miyatsuko Deemed Not to Have Existed ===
The following Kuni no Miyatsuko appear in shrine traditions, in the “Suwa Historical Materials” Volume 28 (the “Suwa Shimo-sha Ōhori (Ohoribe) Takei Iwai Kei Zu Ryaku”), or in what are considered forged texts such as the “{{ill|Sendai Kuji Hongi Taiseikyō|ja|先代旧事本紀大成経|qid=Q11388116}},” the “{{ill|Aso Family Brief Genealogy|ja|阿蘇家略系図}},” the “Shūho Suwa-shi Keizu. Seihen,” “Various Genealogies,” etc. Since these are of low credibility and do not appear in other reliable sources, it is believed these Kuni no Miyatsuko did not actually exist.
